extracted.intended_audience: Promising newly graduated scientists and institutional administrators preparing NIH Director's Early Independence Award (EIA) applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for applying to the NIH Director's Early Independence Award, a program to support newly graduated scientists bypassing postdoctoral training to launch independent research careers. Covers eligibility, application composition, effort and budget requirements, and program emphasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program focus / intent
rubrics_metrics.description: Part of the High-Risk, High-Reward Research program; supports promising, newly graduated scientists to bypass the traditional postdoctoral training period and launch independent research careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on candidates who demonstrate the intellect, scientific creativity, drive, and maturity to begin independent research immediately; projects are expected to align with the HRHR focus on high-risk, high-reward research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single PI only
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must designate a single principal investigator; multi-PI applications are not allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminal degree timing eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipient of terminal research degree or completed postgraduate clinical training within previous 16 months or expectation to do so within following 12 months of application submission date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must meet the specified window relative to the application submission date; timing is a strict eligibility criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current position eligibility (non-independent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Must be in non-independent research position at time of application submission
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should not occupy an independent research position when submitting the application (consistent with the award's purpose to launch independence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional application limit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each eligible institution may submit up to two EIA applications; institutional limits apply and must be adhered to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary data policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are not required to include preliminary data, which supports the program's encouragement of high-risk, novel ideas rather than fully developed preliminary results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required research effort
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires 9.6 months of research effort each year for first 2 years
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awardees must commit substantial research effort (equivalent to 9.6 calendar months/year) during the first two years; this is a condition of the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Reference requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must include between three and five reference letters as part of the submission package; letters presumably should speak to the applicant's qualifications and readiness for independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and award duration
rubrics_metrics.description: $250,000 direct costs per year for up to 5 years
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award provides up to $250,000 in direct costs annually, for a project period of up to five years; applicants should budget accordingly.
